formaldehyde.why: Added at glue blending like urea; specialty chemical costlier to stock than urea

cement.why: Same mill dosing pump as TEA/DEIPA; shelf stability unproven

rebar.why: Batch-plant liquid dispenser; likely lower dose than 15 L/m3 nitrite

boron.why: IX columns after SWRO like NMG resin; replaces 2nd RO pass; regen differs

dioxane.why: Lead-lag media vessels vs UV/peroxide AOP; more media changeouts

siloxane.why: Media swap in existing dual adsorber vessels

mousy.why: Standard tank fining, rack, filter; same steps as PVPP/carbon

smoke.why: Same fining step as activated carbon; no RO unit needed

cork.why: Fining in tank instead of PE contact/filtration step

selenate.why: Sorbent columns replace bioreactor; spent Se media or brine to manage

tfa.why: GAC/IX-style contactors vs RO plant plus brine disposal

lithium.why: Same DLE columns as Al-LDH; elution chemistry may differ

co2.why: TSA bed/fluidized contactor replaces absorber-stripper; no liquid amine handling

ethylene.why: Sachet in carton like KMnO4; avoids oxidizer handling

rareearth.why: Same mixer-settlers; new pH/strip conditions; fewer stages if selective

plastic.why: High-pressure H2 hydrocracker vs simple pyrolysis reactor; needs H2 supply

gold.why: Replaces DBC SX/scrub circuit on chloride leach; tanks and filters

tmah.why: Fits existing resin towers; elution/regeneration steps may change

cesium.why: Same TSCR column skid; requalification; organic less radiation-stable than CST

sulfur.why: Extra adsorber unit after HDS; HDS upgrade is often catalyst swap

phosphate.why: Columns plus regeneration vs dosing pump; fewer bulk ferric deliveries

xenon.why: Adsorber beds on ASU stream replace crude Kr/Xe column

heatcold.why: Same pouch fill line as paraffin packs

chalco.why: Dosed into raffinate like Jetti catalyst; existing heap and SX-EW

ammonium.why: Same ISE probe body; swap membrane cartridge

psensor.why: In-basin probe replaces analyzer plus sample prep; no reagents

magrec.why: Mixer-settlers vs oxalate precipitation tank; organic diluent handling

reecoal.why: Same acid leach plus SX circuit; new extraction conditions

culoop.why: Dosed into the existing coolant loop like tolyltriazole (estimate)

lignin.why: Catalyst swap in the same reductive fractionation reactor as Ni/C (estimate)

coolant.why: Same immersion tanks and pumps; fluid change
